# Afrikakorps spirit logic (GER scope unless noted). Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-12-afrika-korps-mechanic-design.md
# Spirit level effects (MFU_ak_set_sov_idea, MFU_ak_set_desert_tech, MFU_ak_clear_spirit) are generated by
# tools/afrika_korps/generate.py into MFU_afrika_korps_level_effects.txt.
# State on GER: variables MFU_ak_sov (Soviet penalty in points, 0..14), MFU_ak_desert (desert attack in points, 0..10),
# MFU_ak_applied_sov (level last pushed to the recipients); flags MFU_ak_active (decision pressed), MFU_ak_frozen (Barbarossa declared).
# Recipients carry the flag MFU_ak_recipient and copies of the two variables (used by the spirit tooltips).

# Soviet penalty in points = 14 - W, where W is the level of the North African Campaign (ENG holds GER_aatlantic_wall_W;
# 0 = Axis holds all of Africa, 8 = Axis lost it). No else branch: if ENG is gone or holds none of the nine ideas the
# variable keeps its last value.
MFU_ak_compute_sov = {
	if = {
		limit = { ENG = { has_idea = GER_aatlantic_wall_0 } }
		set_variable = { MFU_ak_sov = 14 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { ENG = { has_idea = GER_aatlantic_wall_1 } }
		set_variable = { MFU_ak_sov = 13 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { ENG = { has_idea = GER_aatlantic_wall_2 } }
		set_variable = { MFU_ak_sov = 12 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { ENG = { has_idea = GER_aatlantic_wall_3 } }
		set_variable = { MFU_ak_sov = 11 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { ENG = { has_idea = GER_aatlantic_wall_4 } }
		set_variable = { MFU_ak_sov = 10 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { ENG = { has_idea = GER_aatlantic_wall_5 } }
		set_variable = { MFU_ak_sov = 9 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { ENG = { has_idea = GER_aatlantic_wall_6 } }
		set_variable = { MFU_ak_sov = 8 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { ENG = { has_idea = GER_aatlantic_wall_7 } }
		set_variable = { MFU_ak_sov = 7 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { ENG = { has_idea = GER_aatlantic_wall_8 } }
		set_variable = { MFU_ak_sov = 6 }
	}
}

# Pushes GER's current numbers to every recipient and switches their spirit level and desert tech to match.
MFU_ak_sync = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = MFU_ak_recipient }
		set_variable = { var = MFU_ak_sov value = GER.MFU_ak_sov }
		set_variable = { var = MFU_ak_desert value = GER.MFU_ak_desert }
		MFU_ak_set_sov_idea = yes
		MFU_ak_set_desert_tech = yes
	}
	set_variable = { var = MFU_ak_applied_sov value = MFU_ak_sov }
}

# Called by the decision GER_africa_korps. Recipients are a snapshot of the Germany faction plus EFR and SPR.
MFU_ak_grant = {
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				is_in_faction_with = GER
				tag = GER
				tag = EFR
				tag = SPR
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = MFU_ak_recipient
	}
	set_country_flag = MFU_ak_active
	set_variable = { MFU_ak_desert = 10 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = MFU_ak_sov } }
		set_variable = { MFU_ak_sov = 10 }
	}
	MFU_ak_compute_sov = yes
	MFU_ak_sync = yes
}

# Weekly pulse (on_weekly_GER): keeps the Soviet penalty equal to the Africa swing until Barbarossa is declared,
# whether or not the decision was pressed. Only swaps the spirit when the level changed.
MFU_ak_weekly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_completed_focus = GER_ussr_war_goal }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = MFU_ak_frozen }
		}
		MFU_ak_compute_sov = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = MFU_ak_active
				NOT = { check_variable = { MFU_ak_sov = MFU_ak_applied_sov } }
			}
			MFU_ak_sync = yes
		}
	}
}

# Called first thing when Barbarossa is declared (GER_ussr_war_goal): one last recompute, then the penalty stops tracking.
MFU_ak_freeze = {
	MFU_ak_compute_sov = yes
	set_country_flag = MFU_ak_frozen
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = MFU_ak_active }
		MFU_ak_sync = yes
	}
}

# Monthly pulse (on_monthly_GER): once Barbarossa has frozen the numbers AND it is past 1.1.1942 both drop one point
# a month (first tick 1.2.1942); the spirit ends when both are 0.
MFU_ak_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = MFU_ak_active
			has_country_flag = MFU_ak_frozen
			date > 1942.1.2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { MFU_ak_sov > 0 } }
			add_to_variable = { MFU_ak_sov = -1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { MFU_ak_desert > 0 } }
			add_to_variable = { MFU_ak_desert = -1 }
		}
		MFU_ak_sync = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { MFU_ak_sov = 0 }
				check_variable = { MFU_ak_desert = 0 }
			}
			MFU_ak_end = yes
		}
	}
}

MFU_ak_end = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = MFU_ak_recipient }
		MFU_ak_clear_spirit = yes
		clr_country_flag = MFU_ak_recipient
		clear_variable = MFU_ak_sov
		clear_variable = MFU_ak_desert
	}
	clr_country_flag = MFU_ak_active
	clr_country_flag = MFU_ak_frozen
}
